message.what: G3-G5 geomagnetic storm conditions are ongoing.
message.where: Worldwide and Earth's orbit. Higher-latitude regions and locations with enhanced geoelectric susceptibility face the greatest potential effects.
message.observed: G5 conditions were first observed at 2254 UTC Fri May 10 2024. Warning-level activity is ongoing at 0030 UTC Sat May 11 2024.
message.changed: There is a 75% chance of continued G3 or greater conditions from 0030 UTC Sat May 11 2024 through 0000 UTC Sun May 12 2024. There is a 45% chance of additional G4 or greater periods during the same interval.
message.unchanged: The Warning remains in effect. Additional coronal mass ejection influences may renew activity through 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024.
message.when: Earliest Warning End: 1200 UTC Sat May 11 2024 Latest Warning End: 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024
message.duration: Minimum Remaining Duration: 11 hours 30 minutes Maximum Remaining Duration: 35 hours 30 minutes
message.confidence: Confidence is high that consequential geomagnetic activity will continue from 0030 UTC Sat May 11 2024 through 0000 UTC Sun May 12 2024. Confidence is lower in the timing and strength of additional disturbances expected through 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024.
message.impacts: Power systems may experience voltage-control issues, transformer stress, and isolated equipment trips. Atmospheric drag may lower satellite orbits and reduce tracking and orbit-prediction accuracy. HF communication, precision satellite navigation, and some satellite communications may be intermittently degraded, particularly at higher latitudes. Geomagnetically induced currents may affect pipeline monitoring and corrosion-control systems. Aurora may be visible much farther south than usual where darkness and local viewing conditions allow.
message.precautionary_preparedness_actions: Partners should continue heightened operations, follow sector-specific procedures, and monitor SWPC updates and decision-support guidance.
message.additional_details: This update continues the existing Space Weather Warning. Additional solar disturbances may produce renewed G3-G5 activity through 1200 UTC Sun May 12 2024.
message.next_update: No later than 1230 UTC Sat May 11 2024, or sooner if conditions change.
